title: Emerald Lake Road Bus Tour
includes: Small group size (up to 24 guests per guide)
Hotel pick up and drop off is available on request, please contact us directly.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the Canadian Rockies on a relaxed full-day tour to Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, and Emerald Lake, designed for more than quick photo stops.

At Lake Louise, stroll the shoreline beneath Victoria Glacier and admire the turquoise waters. At Moraine Lake, surrounded by the Ten Peaks, climb the Rockpile for the iconic view or explore at your own pace while your guide shares insights into the region’s glacial history.

Continue into Yoho National Park to visit Emerald Lake, with additional scenic stops at Takakkaw Falls and Natural Bridge.

Throughout the day, your local guide shares stories of geology, wildlife, and conservation. A picnic lunch is included, and small groups ensure a comfortable, well-paced experience.

Highlights:

- Full-day guided tour of Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, and Emerald Lake
- Stops at Takakkaw Falls and Natural Bridge
- Small groups (maximum 24 guests per guide)
- Picnic lunch, snacks, and hotel pick-up and drop-off
